question_summary: Request approval to substitute a fan-powered VAV terminal box in lieu of the specified single-duct VAV unit, citing Section 23 09 00, with no cost or schedule impact.
proposed_solution: Approve use of a fan-powered alternate VAV box in place of the specified single-duct VAV terminal unit; cost-neutral and no effect on equipment delivery schedule.
deadline_text: A response within three business days would be appreciated.
routing_rationale: Mechanical Engineer should evaluate HVAC equipment substitution for performance, controls, and system compatibility, coordinating any electrical impacts.
